about: Source-grounded acceptance for the Ashby decision workspace (D107; docs/audits/2026-09-29-ashby-makeover/ACCEPTANCE.md). Each expectation was written from the named records re-read on their cached documents, which were hash-checked against the digest sources.csv records, before the test that meets it. test/workspace-acceptance.test.js runs the workspace on the compiled database and compares; it also checks that sources.csv still records the digest read here, so a changed document calls for a new reading rather than a silently stale expectation.
reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (an agent), 2026-09-29, from the document cache by digest. No person has reviewed these readings; ACCEPTANCE.md lists what a reviewer should check.

cases.question: XY stiffness at least 4 GPa and heat deflection at least 80 °C, in scope and printable on the H2C, Include uncertain; first without an oven, then with annealing permitted up to 120 °C. Density across, heat deflection up.

noOven.because: Its stiffness is printed only for bars annealed at 120 °C for 16 h, so as printed it has none.

never.because: the as-printed heat deflection is another state's; drawing it beside an annealed pass was A02

pairs.because: p. 4 is the dried table, p. 5 the conditioned one
both from p. 4's dried table, XY flat

cases.question: In scope only, in the conditioned service state, ranked by beam stiffness (E^(1/2) / rho), Confirmed only.

expect.because: Of the in-scope products, those that publish a conditioned state include G048-02, G069-02, G067-06, G031-23, G166-01 and G157-02; G166-01 (Onyx GF) publishes both a conditioned XY modulus (3.1 GPa) and a density, the registry's moisture-invariant value, and since m298 (2026-10-02) so do Raise3D Industrial PET CF (G067-05: its V4.0 sheet's "Conditioned, before annealed" table, XY 5.731 GPa) and Polymaker PolyMide CoPA (G057-03: its V5.5 sheet's "(Wet Status)" table). The test re-derives this list from the products' own states, independently of the ranking. Before D107, 78 materials ranked on a dry first state. Reader round (m342, m345), 2026-10-04: the sheets' conditioned tables were recorded (Raise3D's "Mechanical Properties (Conditioned, before/after annealed)" for Hyper Core PPA-CF and PPA-GF, Industrial PPS-CF and Hyper Speed PLA Pro; Ultrafuse BVOH's "conditioned 23°C, 50% RH 72h" tensile and flexural values; PA12-CF+'s density and its as-printed conditioned table), so PPA-CF (M070), PPA-GF (M071), PPS-CF (M073), PLA (M001), BVOH (M076) and PA12-CF+ (M059) now rank. Onyx GF (M166) ranks as before: its sheet's conditioning at 52 % RH "unless otherwise noted" heads its mechanical tests, not its density (page statements narrowed in m354, 2026-10-05). Sheets that say only "conditioned at room temperature for 24 h" state no moisture and are not conditioned.

cases.question: The H2C beam of the review: scope and the three print gates, XY stiffness at least 3 GPa, density at most 1250 kg/m³, dry and as printed, Confirmed only.

expect.because: The original eight materials remain passing. Campaign m271 adds M147 / G147-01 after independently re-reading exact PAHT9825 FFF guide bed<80C and non-heated-chamber instructions; its existing comparable stiffness/density and270-290C nozzle are unchanged. No application or environmental claim establishes this pass. The decision set is every passing product whose own judged state publishes both values, re-derived in the test from the products' states, not from the workspace. The error-class sweep (m288) adds M017 / G017-05: its own sheet's row "Room Temp. | Room Temperature", which the import had not read, settles its chamber gate; its stiffness and density are unchanged. Reader round (m342), 2026-10-04: M070 (PPA-CF) no longer passes: CarbonX HTN+CF (G070-05) prints "Heated Chamber: Recommended" with no temperature, which wins over the guide's reading and leaves the chamber gate unknown, so the pass set is nine.
